population: All original40k prefixes; all16 sampled next-label draws per prefix, with duplicate suffix rows suppressed
construction: Only rebuild the exact k0 checkpoint from the original permutation stream; read next labels from immutable fork CSVs; no tail RNG or replay
new_cycles: e-c, dimension of newly created graph-cycle space
contact_rank: R0 only: integer period image of alpha_e-alpha_anchor within the same old occupied component; -1 for R1/R2
r0_null_cycle_rank: R0 only: e-c-contact_rank; for a safe R0 insertion all e-c cycles are nullhomologous/contractible
r0_rank2_arch: 0 for R0 nonrank2;1 for one old component supplying rank2 (at least3 contacts);2 for two independent rank1 old components with2+2 contacts;-1 outsideR0
R1_R2: e,c,e-c and recorded old/next rank remain available; no spanning-tree-dependent new-winding label is named
dependence: Draw-weighted descriptive marks on the same original prefix/fork block, not independent new evidence
